status: Completed measurement, NOT production asynchronous mount acceptance

validation.external_lazy_unmount_probes: FAILED in both binaries; retained, not suppressed

limitations: Fresh client mounts, warm daemon OS page cache; shared-file/random client cache hits are disclosed.
Sequential op is one verified 16MiB file; random op is one verified 4KiB pread, not necessarily one RPC.
Local random uses 100 operations per reader; delayed random uses 32.
Three alternating paired trials; ratios of medians, absolute host-dependent values are reference only.

Baseline four synchronous FUSE workers/eight RPC permits; candidates four async FUSE workers/eight,sixteen,thirty-two RPC permits. Matched16 control uses sixteen synchronous workers/sixteen RPC permits.
A short test invocation overlapped startup of the first local-c16 trial; later trials and all other matrices were isolated from tests. All trials are retained.
Prototype instrumentation adds RPC high-water atomic counters, no extra runtime workers.
Daemon cgroup memory.peak includes file cache; delayed-c8 baseline outlier 298057728 bytes must not be interpreted as a universal memory reduction.
External lazy unmount with open handles reports EINVAL and exits before reliable task join in both binaries. No claim that live in-flight teardown acceptance passed.
No per-request FUSE INTERRUPT integration, supported macOS/Windows async adapters, changed kernel queue/block sizes, public default changes or release.
Source checksums are closeout snapshot including later test/harness additions; measured binary SHA256 and raw trial files identify the actual executed prototypes.
